stem: Which of these is a key differential diagnosis for a lateral neck mass specifically in the infantile age group, characterized as a fibroma of the muscle?
explanation: This is a benign fibromatosis of the sternocleidomastoid muscle commonly seen in infants.
rationale: Identify the muscle-specific lesion mentioned as common in infants.

optionExplanations.A: A ranula is a mucous extravasation cyst related to the sublingual gland, not a muscle tumor.
optionExplanations.B: This is a benign fibromatosis of the sternocleidomastoid muscle commonly seen in infants.
optionExplanations.C: As the name suggests, this is a midline structure, not a lateral muscular mass.
optionExplanations.D: Branchial cysts are typically found in older children and are not primary tumors of the muscle.

source.hint: Identify the muscle-specific lesion mentioned as common in infants.
